summary: No further change is proposed; the standing update.json is the accepted multi-requester record. The batched ReadIndex context substitution is now supported by eight receipts: follower, sequential control, logical-deadline timeout, leader-side observer, observer endpoint with control, tick-driven with single-read control, shared local/remote confirmation, and a three-read batch in which both earlier requests stayed at index zero while only the newest completed. The client surface is mapped to SyncRead and ReadIndex/ReadLocalNode with ErrTimeout as the stranded endpoint, the fault is narrowed to the remote reply branch, and three independent suspicions are refuted with sources. Every question is explained with its knowledge uses recorded by exact revision, no necessary gaps remain, and the outstanding limitations are inherent to the in-memory harness rather than addressable by another variant of this cause.
